clues.title: Property Inspection Voice Notes & Photos to Multi-Portal Listing Generator
clues.quote: After every unit turnover inspection, my photos on the phone get mixed up and I spend 2 hours typing room dimensions and utility details into three listing portals.
clues.persona_context: Residential leasing agent handling 10+ unit turnovers per month
clues.input_data: Phone walkthrough photos + 2-minute voice memo of unit features
clues.output_data: Room-tagged photo gallery + formatted listing copy for Zillow, Apartments.com, and Facebook

clues.title: WhatsApp/SMS Tenant Repair Photo Triage & Vendor Quote Matcher
clues.quote: Whenever a tenant texts a blurry photo of a leaking pipe at 10pm, I have to manually ask follow-up questions and copy-paste details to three plumbers for quotes.
clues.persona_context: Independent landlord managing 15 rental units alongside a day job
clues.input_data: Tenant photo + text message describing appliance or plumbing issue
clues.output_data: Diagnostic checklist + standardized work order sent to preferred vendors

clues.title: AI Balcony Plant Feng Shui Visualizer for Renters
clues.quote: I wish I could see how different decorative plants look on my apartment balcony before buying.
